description: Puts two or three of the cars that `see_cars_near_buyer` returned side by side. It takes their `handles`. It answers `cars` (each with a short `title`, and `condition`, new or used, when the listing says) and `rows`: year, trim, exterior color, mileage and the listed price, one value per car. `same` is true when every car has the same value, false when they differ, and null when a car has no value. A value a car does not have is null. The listed price is before taxes and dealer fees. The answer names no dealership.

handles.description: Two or three handles from see_cars_near_buyer. A handle works for 24 hours.

name: compare_listings
title: Compare cars
